I fixed the remaining width overflow at 320px with 200% text, but it is not verified: I didn't run the proof command or a browser, as you asked. This was CSS only; `app.js` and `index.html` are untouched.

**Files changed** (both in `design/prototypes/lsatu-dashboard/new-versions/11-claude-studio/`):
- `style.css`:
  - The page grid, the lower Home grid (assignments and week), the day list and every day row now use `minmax(0,1fr)` instead of `1fr`. This applies in the base rules and in the 1279px, 999px, 720px and 640px breakpoints. A card can no longer grow wider than its column.
  - In the day list, the note column is now `minmax(0,1fr)`. The note itself ("Session 7:15", "No session", "Today") can wrap, so "Session" and "7:15" fall onto separate lines when the row is short of room.
  - Nothing is clipped, overflow isn't hidden, and text sizes are unchanged. The round 1 fixes and the rest of the design are as they were.
- `README.md`: a dated "Fix round 2" section explaining the cause and the fix, plus updated verification notes.

**Proof output:** none from me. I made no shell or browser attempts this round.

**Denied or blocked actions:** none this round. The earlier denials of `node --check` stand.

**Deviations:** none. The containment matches what your fresh reviewer verified in the browser. I also applied `minmax(0,1fr)` to the main Home grid and the seven-column day layouts, so every track behaves the same way.

**For your recheck:** at 320px with 200% text, a long day note may wrap to a second line on the narrowest rows, which is intended. The `node --check` proof also still needs running on your side.
